notes: Adapted from the fork's single shared warlock preset (ui/warlock/apls/rotation.apl.json). Kept Immolate maintenance, the Shadowburn execute, and Life Tap; fixed the same stale Shadow Bolt rank (25307 cast at rank 9 where the build's top rank is 10) and moved the Shadowburn execute condition from a fixed remaining-fight-time check to isExecutePhase(E20), matching the target-health idiom used elsewhere in this lane rather than only firing at the very end of a fight. Amplify Curse and Demonic Sacrifice were dropped: Destruction does not talent into either. Immolate is now cast at prepull so the DoT is already ticking when the fight opens. Conflagrate (1293817) and Incinerate (412758) are Forever's own tier 3 and tier 6 Destruction talents -- the base wowsims/classic Destruction tree has neither -- and both require Immolate on the target, so Incinerate replaces Shadow Bolt as the default filler and Conflagrate is only attempted while Immolate is active. Every rank named here is checked against the spellconst of the newest client build in builds/.

priorityList.notes: Potion at the top of the fight if mana is already below 75 percent.
Life Tap to keep casting once mana runs low.
Immolate is the DoT both Conflagrate and Incinerate need on the target, so it is refreshed the moment it falls off.
Conflagrate consumes part of Immolate's remaining damage as instant burst; only worth casting while Immolate is up.
Shadowburn as the execute finisher below 20 percent target health.
Incinerate is the default filler: it deals bonus damage while Immolate is active, which this rotation keeps up throughout.
